records.jp: すみませーん。<CR>新刊一冊欲しいんですけど
records.en_original: Excuse me, could I get a copy of the latest volume?
records.en: Excuse me, could I get a copy of the latest volume?

records.jp: あ、あとそれとー<CR>よかったらスケブお願いしてもいいですか？
records.en_original: Oh, and I'd like to commission a piece as well...
records.en: Oh, and I'd like to commission a piece as well...

records.jp: す、スケブ……
records.en_original: C-commission...?
records.en: C-commission...?

records.jp: 忙しかったら大丈夫なんですけど
records.en_original: I can come back if you're busy.
records.en: I can come back if you're busy.

records.jp: えっ、あっ、いやその
records.en_original: Erm, uhh, no, it's just...
records.en: Erm, uhh, no, it's just...

records.jp: 先生が描く女の子、すごくかわいいから。<CR>ぜひ直筆でもらいたいなって
records.en_original: The girls you draw are just so cute. I'd love to have an original someday!
records.en: The girls you draw are just so cute. I'd love to have an original someday!

records.jp: すごく……かわいい……
records.en_original: You think...they're cute...?
records.en: You think...they're cute...?

records.jp: 伶那さん、ガッチガチ
records.en_original: Don't be so tense, Rena!
records.en: Don't be so tense, Rena-san!

records.jp: だって、私の本をわざわざ買いに来てくれたと<CR>思ったら……
records.en_original: I didn't think you'd go through all the trouble to come and buy my book...
records.en: I didn't think you'd go through all the trouble to come and buy my book...

records.jp: 通販はしたことあるんでしょ？
records.en_original: You've sold stuff online, haven't you?
records.en: You've sold stuff online, haven't you?

records.jp: だって通販はお客さんと顔を合わせないし
records.en_original: Yes, but you don't have to talk to customers face-to-face online.
records.en: Yes, but you don't have to talk to customers face-to-face online.

records.jp: どうしよう、このままじゃ<CR>まともに対応できない……
records.en_original: Oh, what should I do? If I can't handle this, how can I handle a real interaction...?
records.en: Oh, what should I do? If I can't handle this, how can I handle a real interaction...?

records.jp: 客じゃなくて仲間と思えばいいんだよ
records.en_original: Just think of them as friends, not customers.
records.en: Just think of them as friends, not customers.

records.jp: 仲間？
records.en_original: As friends?
records.en: As friends?

records.jp: だって、伶那さんと趣味が合うから<CR>買ってくれるんでしょ？
records.en_original: People buy your books because they share your tastes, don't they?
records.en: They buy them because they share your tastes, Rena-san, right?

records.jp: この人も仲間なんだ、嬉しいって気持ちで接したら<CR>気が楽になるんじゃないかな
records.en_original: So thinking of them as friends will help you relax, and you'll feel happy that they came to see you.
records.en: So thinking of them as friends will help you relax, and you'll feel happy that they came to see you.

records.jp: ……そっか。<CR>同人誌って本来そういうものか
records.en_original: Yeah... That's how indie comics should be.
records.en: Yeah... That's how indie comics should be.

records.jp: お金をやり取りするから、悪いもの渡せないって<CR>変に力が入ってたのかも
records.en_original: But I was always so hung up on my fear of giving them a bad product for their hard-earned money.
records.en: But I was always so hung up on my fear of giving them a bad product for their hard-earned money.

records.jp: プロ意識高……
records.en_original: The mark of a true professional...
records.en: The mark of a true professional...

records.jp: （それだけ真剣に同人誌作ってるんだな）
records.en_original: (She's quite serious about her comics.)
records.en: (She's quite serious about her comics.)

records.jp: このままでいいんじゃない？
records.en_original: I think you'll be fine.
records.en: I think you'll be fine.

records.jp: なんで？
records.en_original: You do?
records.en: You do?

records.jp: 緊張してるっていうのは、それだけお客さんに会えて<CR>嬉しいからでしょ？
records.en_original: Yeah! If you're nervous, that must mean that you're happy to have customers.
records.en: Yeah! If you're nervous, that must mean that you're happy to have customers.

records.jp: その気持ちは今のままでも伝わってるよ
records.en_original: I'm sure your fans would realize that too.
records.en: I'm sure your fans would realize that too.

records.jp: それならいいけど……
records.en_original: I hope so, but...
records.en: I hope so, but...

records.jp: なにより、ガチガチの伶那さんかわいいし
records.en_original: Most importantly, stiff and nervous Rena is the cutest Rena!
records.en: Most importantly, stiff and nervous Rena-san is the cutest Rena!

records.jp: かっ、からかってるでしょ！
records.en_original: Okay, now you're just making fun of me!
records.en: Okay, now you're just making fun of me!

records.jp: いやいや、本当だよ
records.en_original: No no, I mean it!
records.en: No no, I mean it!

records.jp: うう……
records.en_original: Ugh...
records.en: Ugh...

records.jp: で、これが伶那さんが作った同人誌か。<CR>読んでもいい？
records.en_original: So this is your original comic. Mind if I read it?
records.en: So this is the doujinshi you made, Rena-san. Can I read it?

records.jp: 恥ずかしいけど、ここまできたら見せるしかないから
records.en_original: It's embarrassing, but... We've come this far, so I guess I have no choice.
records.en: It's embarrassing, but... We've come this far, so I guess I have no choice.

records.jp: 楽しみだなぁ、どんなのだろ
records.en_original: I'm excited! I wonder what it's about...
records.en: I'm excited! I wonder what it's about...

records.jp: （マジか……）
records.en_original: (Seriously...?)
records.en: (Seriously...?)

records.jp: （主人公の勇者が故郷を出るぞ！　って決意するとこで<CR>１巻が終わったんだけど）
records.en_original: (It took the entire first volume just for the main character to leave their hometown?!)
records.en: (It took the entire first volume just for the main character to leave their hometown?!)

records.jp: 描写が緻密だね
records.en_original: You really included a lot of detail.
records.en: You really included a lot of detail.

records.jp: そ、そう？<CR>長すぎるかとも思ったんだけど
records.en_original: Y-you think so? I was worried it was too long.
records.en: Y-you think so? I was worried it was too long.

records.jp: （長すぎるっていう自覚あったんだ）
records.en_original: (So even she knows it's too long.)
records.en: (So even she knows it's too long.)

records.jp: 心の動きとか、セリフを言った理由とか、時代背景とか<CR>一つ一つ説明してたら止まらなくなっちゃって
records.en_original: I couldn't stop myself from including every character's thought process, the reasons behind their actions, the historical context...
records.en: I couldn't stop myself from including every character's thought process, the reasons behind their actions, the historical context...

records.jp: でも「緻密」なんて言ってもらえるなんて……
records.en_original: I'm so happy to hear someone call it detailed.
records.en: I'm so happy to hear someone call it detailed.

records.jp: （……うん。伶那さんが喜んでるならいいや！）
records.en_original: (...Yeah. Well as long as Rena's happy!)
records.en: (...Yeah. Well as long as Rena-san's happy!)

records.jp: このシリーズ、何巻くらい出す予定なの？
records.en_original: How many volumes do you plan on writing for this series?
records.en: How many volumes do you plan on writing for this series?

records.jp: そうね……勇者が冒険に出るまでに３巻は<CR>使いたいでしょ
records.en_original: Well... I want to write at least two more before the hero sets out on their adventure.
records.en: Well... I want to write at least two more before the hero sets out on their adventure.

records.jp: 最初の街で大事な出会いがあるから、<CR>そこで５巻は使いたいし……
records.en_original: And they make some important connections in the first town, so that'll be another 5 volumes...
records.en: And they make some important connections in the first town, so that'll be another 5 volumes...

records.jp: （めちゃくちゃ大長編作ろうとしてる！）
records.en_original: (She's writing a freaking epic!)
records.en: (She's writing a freaking epic!)

records.jp: （まぁでも１冊が薄いし……創作意欲があるってことは<CR>悪いことではないはず。たぶん）
records.en_original: (But I guess each volume is pretty thin... And besides, it's good that she has a creative drive...)
records.en: (But I guess each volume is pretty thin... And besides, it's good that she has a creative drive...)

records.jp: ところで伶那さんは同人イベントって<CR>行ったことあるの？
records.en_original: By the way, Rena, have you ever been to a comic convention?
records.en: By the way, Rena-san, have you ever been to a comic convention?

records.jp: それが、まだなくて
records.en_original: No, not yet.
records.en: No, not yet.

records.jp: まずはお客さんとして行ってみたら？
records.en_original: Wanna try going to one as an attendee?
records.en: Wanna try going to one as an attendee?

records.jp: でも、出展したいとか言っておいて<CR>変な話だけど……勇気が出なくて
records.en_original: I don't even have the guts to do that... Yet I keep saying I want to sell my work at one someday.
records.en: I don't even have the guts to do that... Yet I keep saying I want to sell my work at one someday.

records.jp: 私がついていくよ
records.en_original: I'll go with you!
records.en: I'll go with you!

records.jp: え、いいの？
records.en_original: Really? You'd do that?
records.en: Really? You'd do that?

records.jp: うん。元々こういうの好きだし。<CR>行ってみたいなってずっと思ってたから
records.en_original: Sure. I like comics, and I've always wanted to go to an event like that.
records.en: Sure. I like comics, and I've always wanted to go to an event like that.

records.jp: せっかくなら始発で行って並びたいんだけど……
records.en_original: If we're actually gonna go, I'd want to catch the first train and wait in line until it opens...
records.en: If we're actually gonna go, I'd want to catch the first train and wait in line until it opens...

records.jp: もちろん。むしろ最初からそのつもりだったよ
records.en_original: Of course! That goes without saying!
records.en: Of course! That goes without saying!

records.jp: 熱量が同じ……
records.en_original: Wow, we're on the same page...
records.en: Wow, we're on the same page...

records.jp: よかった。<CR>ありがとう、星崎さん
records.en_original: Thanks, Hoshizaki!
records.en: Thanks, Hoshizaki-san!

records.jp: コスプレして行ったら？
records.en_original: Why don't you go in cosplay?
records.en: Why don't you go in cosplay?

records.jp: そっ、そんなの余計に恥ずかしいでしょ！
records.en_original: Are you kidding? I'd be even more nervous!
records.en: Are you kidding? I'd be even more nervous!

records.jp: 元が分からないくらいメイクしちゃえば<CR>知り合いに会っても平気じゃん
records.en_original: If you're wearing so much makeup that no one would recognize you, you won't have to worry about running into someone you know.
records.en: If you're wearing so much makeup that no one would recognize you, you won't have to worry about running into someone you know.

records.jp: それに自分以外の人格借りた方が、<CR>緊張和らぐ気がする
records.en_original: Besides, you might feel less nervous if you pretended you were someone else.
records.en: Besides, you might feel less nervous if you pretended you were someone else.

records.jp: そう言われればそうかも
records.en_original: You might be right...
records.en: You might be right...

records.jp: 衣装選びとか手伝うからさ、ね？
records.en_original: I'll help you choose a costume, okay?
records.en: I'll help you choose a costume, okay?

records.jp: それを口実に、私をおもちゃにしようとしてるでしょ
records.en_original: You're just using me to play dress-up, aren't you?
records.en: You're just using me to play dress-up, aren't you?

records.jp: そんなわけないじゃん。<CR>伶那さんの新たな可能性を探したいだけだよ
records.en_original: Of course not! I just want you to explore new possibilities, Rena!
records.en: Of course not! I just want you to explore new possibilities, Rena-san!

records.jp: 本当に？<CR>……まあ、考えるだけならしてもいいけど
records.en_original: Really? ...Well, there's no harm in thinking about it, I guess.
records.en: Really? ...Well, there's no harm in thinking about it, I guess.

records.jp: フラグメント「<CLGR>%s<CLNR>」を<CR>手に入れました
records.en_original: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
